page.overview:
Who is Dot's Friends?

Dot's Friends are supporting characters in A Bug's Life.

"Dot's pals make fun of her faith in Flik. When the kids see Flik smash into a rock while crossing the dry creekbed on a dandelion seed, one boy tells the other "Your dad's right. He's gonna die." But Dot's belief never wavers."

They first appear climbing out of the ground where Aphie's standing. They ditch Dot while she tries to catch up, but fails due to her wings.

They appear again following Flik to a dry creekbed with Dot. One of them thinks Flik is looking for dandelions, until Flik grabs one and then flies off. The boys cheer for Flik until he smashes into a rock. One of them thinks the other's dad is right that Flik is gonna die searching for warrior bugs.
